gloss: to look the part; to look good

definitions.gloss: to look the part; to look good; to come off well
definitions.explanation: To look right and convincing at something: a pose, an outfit or a skill that fits the person and looks natural. Often of someone who has improved, or with a negative for an awkward beginner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{様|さま}になっている。
examples.english: She looks good in a kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{様|さま}になってきた。
examples.english: After practice, it's finally starting to look right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧{様|さま}になって⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My son, in a suit for the first time, didn't look the part at all yet.

notes:
Intransitive and godan: {様|さま}になる, {様|さま}になった; usually in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form ({様|さま}になって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧) to describe how someone looks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{様|さま}になる: to look good whatever one does
- {様|さま}になってきた: to begin to look the part
- {全然|ぜんぜん}{様|さま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to look completely awkward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to make a good picture — of a scene or a person, as if worth painting
- ⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧: to suit — of clothes or a style fitting a person
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つく: to become second nature, to look at home in a role
